geography: Reported effect location; accuracy, datum and CRS unverified. No station identity crosswalk.
grain: One raw NCEI runup record occurrence per source page; duplicate IDs are retained.

native_field_semantics.arrDay/arrHour/arrMin: Initial-wave UTC calendar day/hour/minute as reported.
native_field_semantics.travHours/travMins: Initial-wave duration from source to effect location.
native_field_semantics.typeMeasurementId: Requested gauge categories: 2 tide gauge, 3 deep ocean gauge.

raw_preservation: Original JSON bytes remain at raw_path with SHA256; raw_record_json preserves all fields.
science: All model_eligible and physical_onset_validated flags remain false.

target.eligibility: Complete unique-ID pagination, hours>=0, minutes0..59, sum>0; doubtful=n; publish=true; measurement2/3; no invalid coordinates. Missing coordinate components are retained as unknown and do not imply a deployment.
target.meaning: Explicit complete positive initial-wave reported travel duration.
